id: title:frankh:detect blanket or group in rollout check

review.posthog_relevance: Changes the release-condition evaluation for persisted feature flags, potentially affecting how PostHog determines if a feature is fully rolled out when multiple blanket groups exist.
review.reason: Replaces a restrictive single-group, 100%-only, no-properties, no-variant check with an OR-based check: returns True if ANY group lacks properties, lacks variant, and has rollout_percentage None or 100. This could affect how PostHog evaluates release conditions for persisted feature flags.
